summary: This note describes Wydarzenia ("Events"), the news program of Polsat, which the note calls Poland's second biggest television channel. It states that Tomasz Lis created the program in 2004 and that Dorota Gawryluk is the current editor-in-chief. The program is produced and aired from Polsat News studios in Warsaw.
one_line: Wydarzenia is the news program of Polsat, produced from Polsat News studios in Warsaw, created by Tomasz Lis in 2004.
key_facts: Wydarzenia (translated as "Events") is the news program of Polsat.
Polsat is described in the note as Poland's second biggest television channel.
The creator of Wydarzenia was Tomasz Lis, in 2004.
Dorota Gawryluk is the current editor-in-chief of Wydarzenia.
Wydarzenia is produced and aired from Polsat News studios in Warsaw.
